title: Task acceptance: one member's act of accepting a map (a board set), in three layers, pinned to the board's version and sha256

version.description: state.version of the board set (its cycle when it has none)

sha256.description: sha256 of the board file: any edit, a comment too, voids the acceptance

vocabulary.description: layer 1: the terms the map uses, read as the pack's ontology gives them

elements.description: layer 2: element id of the board set to the member's act; an element not listed counts as not_read

check.description: layer 3: whether someone outside the group checked the map against its sources

checked_by.description: who checked it; only when check is done
